server.name: Debian 13
server.sessions: Wayland: GNOME, KDE Plasma, sway; Xorg: the default session

server.name: Fedora 45
server.sessions: Wayland: GNOME (the default), KDE Plasma, sway; Xorg: with xorgxrdp, below

windows.command: Invoke-WebRequest https://github.com/congzhangzh/rdp-release-kit/releases/download/20261028.2/freerdp-host-20261030.1-windows-x86_64.zip -OutFile freerdp-host.zip; Expand-Archive freerdp-host.zip; Set-Location freerdp-host\freerdp-host-*; .\freerdp-shadow-service.exe install --allow-sas -- /bind-address:127.0.0.1 /gfx-av1

mac.command: curl -LO https://github.com/congzhangzh/rdp-release-kit/releases/download/20261028.2/freerdp-host-20261102.2-macos-arm64.zip && ditto -x -k freerdp-host-20261102.2-macos-arm64.zip . && cd freerdp-host-20261102.2-macos-arm64 && cp -R FreeRDP-Shadow.app /Applications/ && xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/FreeRDP-Shadow.app && cp org.freerdp.shadow.plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ && launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/org.freerdp.shadow.plist
mac.then: Then allow FreeRDP Shadow in System Settings > Privacy & Security, under Screen Recording and Accessibility, and run: launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/org.freerdp.shadow

mac.command: curl -LO https://github.com/congzhangzh/rdp-release-kit/releases/download/20261028.2/freerdp-host-20261102.2-macos-x86_64.zip && ditto -x -k freerdp-host-20261102.2-macos-x86_64.zip . && cd freerdp-host-20261102.2-macos-x86_64 && cp -R FreeRDP-Shadow.app /Applications/ && xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/FreeRDP-Shadow.app && cp org.freerdp.shadow.plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ && launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/org.freerdp.shadow.plist
mac.then: Then allow FreeRDP Shadow in System Settings > Privacy & Security, under Screen Recording and Accessibility, and run: launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/org.freerdp.shadow

av2.what: AV2: xrdp sends it to the clients that offer it (the kit's FreeRDP clients and FreeRDP Web) once it is first in the codec order
av2.command: sudo sed -i 's/^order = \[ "AV1"/order = [ "AV2", "AV1"/' /etc/xrdp/gfx.toml && sudo systemctl restart xrdp
